I have the Q3 numbers, but I can't give you the Q2 comparison. The Q2 figures in `reports/q2_summary.md` (mean 3.9, 58% recommend, n = 412) were withdrawn on 2026-07-30. A weighting error counted the West region twice, and the note says "do not cite the draft." Corrected Q2 figures haven't been published yet, so the change column stays N/A for now.

**Q3 2026 customer survey (responses from Aug 31 to Sep 28)**

| Metric | Q3 | Change vs Q2 |
|---|---|---|
| Customers who responded | **460** | N/A |
| Mean satisfaction (1–5) | **3.58** | N/A |
| Would recommend | **68%** (302 of 442) | N/A |

How I got these, following `codebook.md`:
- **Respondents:** The file has 480 rows. Some customers edited their answers, so I kept only each customer's latest submission, which leaves 460.
- **Satisfaction:** I left out 35 customers who didn't answer (coded -99), so the mean is based on 425 answers.
- **Recommend:** I left out 18 blank answers, so the share is based on 442. If you count those 18 as "not yes", the figure is 66% of all 460.

Once the corrected Q2 numbers come out, send them over and I'll fill in the change column.
